name: Coursera API
tagline: Enterprise APIs for Coursera Business, Campus, and Government catalog and learner data
description: Coursera provides OAuth 2.0–authenticated REST APIs for Coursera Business, Campus, and Government customers to programmatically access organization data: course catalogs, enrollments, learner progress, and related learning-platform resources. Access is not self-serve public; it is available to enterprise/organization customers via Coursera’s developer portal (dev.coursera.com). Public course-catalog browsing without a contract is not the primary supported path.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0 bearer access tokens (Authorization: Bearer). Enterprise customer access via Coursera developer portal; not open self-serve for arbitrary developers.

pricing.free_tier_limits: no free tier (enterprise customer APIs; access requires Coursera Business/Campus/Government relationship)
pricing.paid_plans: Included with Coursera Business, Campus, or Government enterprise contracts; pricing not published as a public API product

use_cases: list courses available to a Coursera Business organization
fetch learner enrollment and progress for an enterprise cohort
sync Coursera catalog offerings into an LMS or internal learning portal
retrieve program and specialization metadata for partner integrations
